sprint: Studio Frame Personalization — a Story Author's Own Picture as a Place's Frame
task: The user's own single governing request: 'also studio is not providing options to personalize frames. allow studio to put image as frame. and also change the size and shape of place if story author has allowed it.' This ships the first half only; Place resize+shape remains a separate, not-yet-started task. Investigation confirmed Studio has two parallel frame-styling systems -- Picture Border/Frame Style (cardOverrides.border, Place-aware) and the separate Artwork Theme frameVariation system -- with _resolveBorder's precedence NOT layered, so cardOverrides.border always wins outright once set; Picture Border is the system extended. _resolveBorder's two branches (per-Place and global/Place-1) gained image/imageRotation fields, absent for every existing project. _drawPictureFrameFill gained an optional trailing slide parameter (for AssetStore's cross-owner recallOwnerId fallback) and a new hasBorderImageBg branch resolved via _ensureDecorationImage (the Draft Asset Architecture vihu-asset:/data: path with crossOrigin already set), never ThemeRegistry.resolveAssetRef -- a Story Author's own upload isn't a Theme asset. Cover-fit plus optional rotation, clipped to the frame's own shape path, confirmed mutually exclusive by construction with the pre-existing Artwork-Theme image-background case. js/cardDesigner.js gained a new _storeUploadedAsset helper (mirrored from contextPanel.js's own identical pattern), a new 'Your Own Picture' fill chip with a hidden file input, and a Rotation slider + Remove button shown only while that fill is active -- all gated by the exact same locked=(!hasImage||!editable) computation every other Frame Style control already uses, so Creator Governing Rule #2 (Guardrails) is honoured with zero separate permission check needed. Verified end-to-end via a new 25-assertion Playwright suite (real file upload, real pixel sampling confirming the canvas genuinely repaints and genuinely reverts on Remove, and a locked-Place scenario confirming the chip is genuinely disabled). Full regression: 4 previously-ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED scratch suites sharing this render path (a pre-existing, already-documented hardcoded-port staleness class, not a real regression) were re-verified genuinely passing after starting a real server on the hardcoded port, rather than dismissed; 8 further relevant existing suites all pass unchanged; both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2) pass unchanged, confirming zero impact on either Builder-tooling surface -- this feature is confined entirely to root Studio. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Builder architecture change; confined to renderer/slideRenderer.js, js/cardDesigner.js, and css/style.css.
